dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the wide mid-body section toward a sharp posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical deviations or structural bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark aperture (blowhole) located on the anterior dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge visible as a low-contrast linear feature along the posterior half of the central axis.
